title: The Outsider III
description:
The Outsider III marks the next chapter in our ongoing collaboration with our friend and celebrated author, David Coggins — a man whose life is split between far-flung rivers and well-worn barstools, and who demands a boot that can keep up with both.

Designed as a modern companion for a life lived outdoors and in good company, the Outsider III is a custom apron-toe Chukka built for versatility. Cut from rich Bison Janus calf suede sourced from the storied C.F. Stead tannery, it’s rugged enough for walking through pine forests yet refined enough to wear fireside with a whiskey in hand.

Beneath its understated silhouette lies Viberg’s Channeled Insole Goodyear Welt construction — our closest approach to traditional hand-welting. This time-honored method means each pair can be resoled and recrafted for decades of wear. And because your foot rests directly atop the insole and welt that bind the boot together, it will gradually conform to the shape of your foot, becoming more comfortable with each wear.

title: Studio019: The Parka
description:
Born from the rugged spirit of 1930's fishermen's jackets, The Parka pays homage to heritage style while embracing the present. Originally crafted to withstand the harshest seas, it's now reimagined into a modern, utilitarian silhouette while preserving the soul of the original style. The modern lines of the parka are realized in water-resistant Italian fabric and elevated through refined trims and finishes.

This is not just outerwear; it's a legacy of transformed - built to last, made to be worn, lived in and one day, proudly passed down to the next generation.

Extremely limited edition.

Made in Italy

 

Founded by longtime friends and industry veterans, Enrico - a master patternmaker and clothing technician - and Alan, with global experience in product development and production, the S_019 brand is rooted in a shared love for vintage menswear and timeless craftsmanship. 

Made in Italy

title: Studio019: The Overcoat

Its clean lines and timeless elegance establish it as a true wardrobe anchor: iconic, functional, and enduring. Built to wear and to pass down to the next generation.

Its clean lines and timeless elegance establish it as a true wardrobe anchor: iconic, functional, and enduring.

title: Studio019: The Peacoat
description:
A modern take on the traditional sailor's peacoat, this piece balances heritage and function with updated proportions and considered detailing.

Crafted from a robust blend of yarns to create a soft, comfortable feel with movement. The Peacoat is designed to age gracefully—growing softer, richer, and more personal with time. More than simple outerwear, it’s a timeless staple, with a quiet integrity to be treasured today and handed down to be enjoyed by future generations.

Extremely limited edition.

title: The Candle
description:
The Candle was designed exclusively for Viberg in collaboration with expert local artisan perfumer - Flore Botanical Alchemy. Hand poured just minutes away from our factory, the Candle features a smokey and woody scent profile that is reminiscent of the Pacific Northwest that we call home. Every element of the Candle is specialized, including the jar itself. The jar is made of a special violet glass that filters UV light to protect and preserve its natural contents, and can be reused once the Candle has been fully used.

Scent Notes: Bergamot, Orange Peel, Jammy Fir Balsam Sap, Oak Moss, Fig Leaf, Black Tea Tannin, Ho Wood

Scent Profile: Boreal Forest, Mossy, Evergreen, Campfire

Fragrance Family: Leather Chypre


Note: This candle is best burned in 2-3 hour intervals to ensure even burning. It is strongly recommended to trim the wick 5mm after burning and before re-lighting to prevent smoking and burning of the sides of the glass.

title: Pocket T-Shirt White
description:
One of the most iconic pieces of apparel in history, the t-shirt dates back to the early 20th century when young Army and Navy soldiers began incorporating the standard-issue undergarment into their casual wardrobes. 

The garment reached cult status in the 50s after being famously worn by celebrities like Marlon Brando and James Dean.  Our premium take on the Pocket Tee is custom made in Los Angeles from an ultra-soft cotton jersey and features a classic fit for everyday wear.
